hook: a muddy country road in light rain winding through green hills, a long line of horse-drawn wooden wagons loaded with sacks and barrels, merchants in brown hooded cloaks walking beside the horses, on a hilltop far above the road a huge empty upright ring of carved grey stone, overcast, wide shot
gate: a huge empty upright ring of carved grey stone standing in a cobbled city square, a pale violet crystal set at the top of the ring, a merchant in a long blue coat with a small handcart of crates waiting in front of it, onlookers, soft morning light, wide shot
cargo: a wooden horse cart heaped with green cabbages and turnips stopped on a muddy road, a stocky brown horse in harness, a farmer in a patched wool coat holding the reins, grey morning light, medium wide shot, face in soft shadow
village: a small hillside farming village of thatched stone cottages at the end of a muddy rutted track, a horse-drawn wagon arriving along the track, sheep in a field, soft overcast light, wide shot from a distance
queue: a long queue of tired merchants with crates and bundles waiting in a cobbled square before a huge empty upright ring of carved grey stone, a stern official in a grey robe at a wooden desk beside the ring, overcast light, wide shot
courier: night, a lone hooded courier in a dark green riding cloak with a small leather satchel walks toward a huge empty upright ring of carved grey stone in a quiet square lit by lanterns, seen from behind, wide shot
